using namespace Eigen;

int main() {
    // Nodes
    double x[4] = {0.0, 2.0, 2.0, 0.0};
    double y[4] = {0.0, 0.0, 1.5, 1.5};
    double E = 200e9, nu = 0.3, t = 0.01;
    
    // Constitutive matrix (plane stress)
    Matrix3d D;
    double c = E/(1.0 - nu*nu);
    D << c,      c*nu,   0.0,
         c*nu,   c,      0.0,
         0.0,    0.0,    c*(1.0-nu)/2.0;
    
    // Triangle decomposition map (0-indexed): (1,2,4),(2,3,1),(3,4,2),(4,1,3)
    int M[4][3] = {{0,1,3},{1,2,0},{2,3,1},{3,0,2}};
    
    Matrix<double,8,8> K = Matrix<double,8,8>::Zero();
    
    for (int tri = 0; tri < 4; tri++) {
        int n0 = M[tri][0], n1 = M[tri][1], n2 = M[tri][2];
        double x1=x[n0], y1=y[n0];
        double x2=x[n1], y2=y[n1];
        double x3=x[n2], y3=y[n2];
        
        double A2 = (x2-x1)*(y3-y1) - (x3-x1)*(y2-y1); // 2*Area
        double Area = std::abs(A2)/2.0;
        
        // B matrix (3x6)
        Matrix<double,3,6> B;
        B << y2-y3, 0.0, y3-y1, 0.0, y1-y2, 0.0,
             0.0, x3-x2, 0.0, x1-x3, 0.0, x2-x1,
             x3-x2, y2-y3, x1-x3, y3-y1, x2-x1, y1-y2;
        B /= A2;
        
        Matrix<double,6,6> Ktri = t * Area * B.transpose() * D * B;
        
        // Assemble into 8x8
        int nodes[3] = {n0, n1, n2};
